title: Goose Flute Call (5-part kit)
description: Big-bore single-reed goose-style call with a deep flared bell. Same kit layout as the duck call but larger chamber for a lower, honking tone.
use: Birdwatching / hobby calling accessory and acoustics project; use lawfully.
material: PETG or PLA body, 0.16 mm layers; reed from 0.2 mm PET film.
assembly: 1. Press the tone insert into the barrel from the exit end until it seats on the internal shoulder.
2. Lay the reed strip (film) flat on the insert deck, square end toward the mouthpiece, covering the window.
3. Press the clamp wedge in over the reed base, flat face against the reed.
4. Press the end piece (bell/can) spigot into the barrel exit until its flange meets the barrel.
5. Blow a short, sharp breath from the mouthpiece. Move the wedge or trim the reed free-length 1 mm at a time to tune.
fit_notes: Joint clearances: press-fit joints are modelled with 0.10 mm radial clearance (0.20 mm on diameter); sliding joints 0.25 mm radial. If a press-fit is loose wrap one turn of PTFE (plumber) tape or a dab of glue; if tight, sand lightly - do not force. Not tested by test-printing or acoustic measurement. Sound depends on your printer, filament, reed film and fit - expect to tune.
fit_check: parts built in assembled pose and boolean-intersected pairwise: no interference found
